ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixel distribution occupying approximately 85% of the visible ventral area, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the trailing edges and the basal peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) perimeter banding along the superior trailing edges of both lobes. Densely clustered, irregular low-intensity mottling at the central base (peduncle area). Isolated low-intensity punctate spots distributed sparsely across the medial region of the left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of unique reddish-brown pigmentation within the primary linear abrasion on the right lobe, differing from the standard black-white gradient.
